exercises.title: Possessives — Recupera
exercises.description: Distingui possessive adjectives, possessive pronouns e possessive 's.
exercises.instructions: Controlla se dopo il possessivo c'è un nome e chi è il vero possessore.

sections.title: Tre modi per esprimere possesso
sections.instructions: Prima identifica la struttura: possessivo + nome, possessivo da solo oppure nome del possessore + 's.

questions.title: My, mine o Marco's?
questions.prompt: Prima di esercitarti
questions.instructions: Osserva quando ogni forma può stare davanti a un nome e quando può stare da sola.
questions.learning_objective: Distinguish possessive adjectives, possessive pronouns and possessive 's in common ownership contexts.

content.body: Gli aggettivi possessivi vengono prima di un nome: my phone. I possessive pronouns sostituiscono il nome: The phone is mine. Il possessive 's collega un possessore a ciò che possiede: Marco's phone.
content.intro: Chiediti sempre: dopo il possessivo c'è un nome? E chi possiede davvero l'oggetto?

sections.title: Possessive adjective + nome
sections.body: My, your, his, her, its, our, their devono accompagnare un nome.

sections.title: Possessive pronoun da solo
sections.body: Mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs sostituiscono il nome già noto.

sections.title: My ≠ mine
sections.body: La scelta dipende dalla presenza del nome.

correct.text: This is my coat. · This coat is mine.

sections.title: His/her dipende dal possessore
sections.body: Guarda chi possiede, non l'oggetto posseduto.

examples.text: Marco has a sister. His sister is 17.
Anna has a new phone. Her phone is blue.

sections.title: Possessive 's
sections.body: Con persone e relazioni comuni, aggiungi 's al possessore.

sections.title: Whose...?
sections.body: Whose chiede a chi appartiene qualcosa.

examples.text: Whose notebook is this? It's Giulia's.

sections.title: Checklist
points: Whose chiede chi è il proprietario.

questions.title: Nome dopo il possessivo
questions.prompt: Marta has a new laptop. ___ laptop is very light.
questions.learning_objective: Choose a possessive adjective from the owner.

feedback.explanation: Laptop è espresso, quindi serve un possessive adjective: her laptop.

questions.title: Il nome non si ripete
questions.prompt: My phone is black. The blue phone is ___.
questions.learning_objective: Choose a possessive pronoun when the noun is omitted.

feedback.explanation: Dopo is non compare phone: serve yours.

questions.title: Sistema il possessore
questions.prompt: Correggi: This is Marco phone.
questions.learning_objective: Form possessive 's with a person's name.

feedback.explanation: Con Marco come possessore: Marco's phone.

questions.title: Aggettivo o pronome?
questions.prompt: Completa le due frasi.
questions.instructions: Scegli la forma corretta in base alla presenza del nome.
questions.learning_objective: Contrast possessive adjective and possessive pronoun forms.

content.text_template: This is [[blank_1]] desk. The desk near the window is [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: Our desk; the desk is ours.

questions.title: Chiedi chi è il proprietario
questions.prompt: Metti le parole nell'ordine corretto.
questions.learning_objective: Build a simple Whose ownership question.

feedback.explanation: Whose jacket is this?

exercises.title: Possessives — Allenati
exercises.description: Pratica possessive adjectives, pronouns, 's e Whose in contesti quotidiani.
exercises.instructions: Controlla il possessore e se il nome viene espresso o sostituito.

questions.title: Oggetti nello zaino
questions.prompt: Complete with the correct possessive forms.
questions.instructions: Write one form in each gap.
questions.learning_objective: Produce possessive adjectives from different owners.

content.text_template: I have [[blank_1]] notebook. Sara has [[blank_2]] keys. Tom and Mia have [[blank_3]] lunch boxes.

feedback.explanation: Guarda sempre chi possiede l'oggetto.

questions.title: Una forma al posto sbagliato
questions.prompt: Correct: This is hers notebook.
questions.learning_objective: Correct a possessive pronoun incorrectly used before a noun.

feedback.explanation: Davanti a notebook serve her, non hers.

questions.title: Non ripetere il nome
questions.prompt: Our seats are 12 and 13. Seats 14 and 15 are ___.
questions.learning_objective: Choose a possessive pronoun in a shared-ownership context.

feedback.explanation: Seats non si ripete dopo la risposta: theirs.

questions.title: Lost property
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural reply.
questions.learning_objective: Answer a Whose question naturally using possessive 's.

content.scenario: A teacher finds a water bottle.

feedback.explanation: Paolo's può sostituire Paolo's water bottle nel contesto.

questions.title: Traduci senza ripetere il nome
questions.prompt: Questa è la mia scrivania. Quella vicino alla porta è la loro.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a possessive adjective and possessive pronoun in one context.

accepted_answers: This is my desk. The one near the door is theirs.
This is my desk. That one near the door is theirs.

feedback.explanation: My + desk; theirs sostituisce desk.

questions.title: Una relazione familiare
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a sentence with possessive 's and natural noun order.

feedback.explanation: Possessore prima dell'oggetto: my sister's room.

questions.title: Quali frasi sono corrette?
questions.prompt: Select all grammatically correct sentences.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one answer.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise correct adjective, pronoun and possessive 's structures.

feedback.explanation: Ours non può stare davanti a car: our car / the car is ours.

questions.title: Chi possiede cosa?
questions.prompt: Complete the mini-context.
questions.instructions: Choose the forms from the owner and sentence structure.
questions.learning_objective: Track owners across possessive adjective and pronoun forms.

content.text_template: Anna and Leo have a dog. [[blank_1]] dog is called Max. The red lead is [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: Anna and Leo = they: their dog; the lead is theirs.

exercises.title: Possessives — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Applica le forme di possesso in formati tipici di una verifica.
exercises.instructions: Completa tutto prima di vedere il feedback.

questions.title: Complete the sentences
questions.prompt: Complete with the correct possessive form.
questions.instructions: Write one form in each gap.
questions.learning_objective: Produce adjectives and pronouns in school-style completion.

content.text_template: 1. Julia has a bike. [[blank_1]] bike is green. 2. This pen is my pen; that one is [[blank_2]]. 3. We have seats 3 and 4. These seats are [[blank_3]].

feedback.explanation: Her + bike; yours/ours sostituiscono il nome.

questions.title: Correct the mistake
questions.prompt: Correct: This is my brother room.
questions.learning_objective: Correct missing possessive 's in a family relationship.

feedback.explanation: My brother's room.

questions.title: Choose the correct answer
questions.prompt: Whose keys are these?
questions.learning_objective: Answer a Whose question with a natural possessive form.

feedback.explanation: Luca's può stare da solo quando keys è già noto.

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: La loro casa è grande, ma la nostra è più vicina alla scuola.
questions.learning_objective: Translate possessive adjective and pronoun contrast.

accepted_answers: Their house is big, but ours is closer to the school.
Their house is large, but ours is closer to the school.

feedback.explanation: Their + house; ours sostituisce our house.

questions.title: Make a question
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Whose question in school format.

feedback.explanation: Whose phone is on the desk?

questions.title: Complete the contrast
questions.prompt: Choose the correct forms.
questions.learning_objective: Coordinate adjective and pronoun forms in one school-style item.

content.text_template: This is [[blank_1]] classroom. The classroom upstairs is [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: Their classroom; the classroom is ours.

exercises.title: Possessives — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma su adjective/pronoun, possessore, 's, Whose e ordine.
exercises.instructions: Completa senza aiuti. Il feedback arriva solo alla fine.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Guarda chi possiede e se il nome è presente.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: Tom has a red backpack. ___ backpack is under the chair.
questions.learning_objective: Choose a possessive adjective from the owner.

feedback.explanation: Tom = he → his backpack.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.prompt: Complete the ownership contrast.
questions.learning_objective: Produce adjective and pronoun forms in one context.

content.text_template: We have [[blank_1]] tickets. The tickets on the table are [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: Our + tickets; theirs sostituisce their tickets.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.prompt: Correct: That blue jacket is her.
questions.learning_objective: Correct possessive adjective used without a noun.

feedback.explanation: Senza noun dopo, serve hers.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Whose question independently.

feedback.explanation: Whose books are these?

questions.title: Item 5
questions.prompt: Questa è la bici di mia sorella. La mia è in garage.
questions.learning_objective: Produce possessive 's and a possessive pronoun in one translation.

accepted_answers: This is my sister's bike. Mine is in the garage.
This is my sister's bicycle. Mine is in the garage.

feedback.explanation: My sister's bike; mine sostituisce my bike.

questions.title: Item 6
questions.prompt: Select all correct sentences.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one answer.
questions.learning_objective: Discriminate correct adjective, pronoun and genitive forms.

feedback.explanation: Mine non può stare davanti a coat.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural reply.
questions.learning_objective: Respond naturally to an ownership question using the appropriate possessive form.

feedback.explanation: Charger è già noto: hers.

questions.title: Item 8
questions.prompt: Track the owners in the mini-text.
questions.learning_objective: Track owner reference across adjective and pronoun forms.

content.text_template: Luca and I share a desk. [[blank_1]] desk is near the door. The desk near the window is Anna's, so it is [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: Luca and I = we → our desk; Anna's desk = hers.

questions.title: Item 9
questions.prompt: Correct: Maria's brother likes his new school, and Maria likes his school too.
questions.instructions: Correct only the possessive that refers to Maria's school.
questions.learning_objective: Choose his/her from the actual owner in connected context.

accepted_answers: Maria's brother likes his new school, and Maria likes her school too.

feedback.explanation: Il secondo possessore è Maria → her school.

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: Di chi è questa giacca? È di Paolo, ma quella nera è mia.
questions.learning_objective: Produce Whose, possessive 's and possessive pronoun forms in one controlled task.

accepted_answers: Whose jacket is this? It's Paolo's, but the black one is mine.
Whose is this jacket? It's Paolo's, but the black one is mine.

feedback.explanation: Whose...? Paolo's; mine sostituisce my jacket.
